metadata.title: SAR - Missing MTA-STS or TLS-RPT
metadata.remarks: Assessment result identifying institutional email domains where MTA-STS and/or TLS reporting (TLS-RPT) is not enabled or not monitored, contrary to DNS Secure Email SSPP expectations.

findings.title: Missing MTA-STS or TLS-RPT
findings.description: One or more institutional email domains do not enforce MTA-STS and/or do not enable TLS reporting, reducing visibility into transport security failures.

associated-risk.title: Email Transport Downgrade Risk
associated-risk.description: Without MTA-STS and TLS reporting, email delivery may fall back to non-TLS or misconfigured paths without detection.

remediations.title: Enable MTA-STS and TLS-RPT
remediations.description: Publish and enforce MTA-STS policy and enable TLS-RPT with defined monitoring and escalation procedures.

tasks.title: Publish MTA-STS Policy
tasks.description: Publish an enforcing MTA-STS policy for affected domains.

tasks.title: Enable TLS Reporting (TLS-RPT)
tasks.description: Configure TLS-RPT endpoints and define ownership for report review.

tasks.title: Define Monitoring and Escalation
tasks.description: Document review cadence and escalation thresholds for transport security reports.
